TASK (ticket V-67 of the AI-table «Живой мастер» plan): build a self-contained static web page that measures what a touch screen reports, so colleague Алексей can open a public link on the real AI-table screen (a large touch display lying flat, likely 43–55″ PCAP or IR, Chromium) and send us the result. It decides whether physical tokens (miniatures with 3–4 conductive feet in a unique geometry) can be recognised by touch.
Read first: claude-code-game-master/build/ai-table-human-gm/research/physical-tokens.md and claude-code-game-master/build/ai-table-human-gm/PLAN.md §4 (V-67 row in §5).
Write ONLY into claude-code-game-master/build/ai-table-human-gm/touch-lab/ : index.html (inline CSS and JS, no CDN, no external requests, no analytics), optional local font files copied from claude-code-game-master/build/ai-table-redesign/assets/fonts/ for the look. It will be published publicly — no secrets, no internal hostnames or paths in the page.
The page (Russian UI, the AI-table concept look: dark, gold display font Forum, parchment/gold accents from claude-code-game-master/build/ai-table-redesign/tokens.css — copy the few variables you need inline):
1. Full-viewport canvas, no scroll ever (100dvh, overflow hidden, touch-action none, block context menu, pinch, double-tap zoom, text selection).
2. Draws every active pointer: a ring with id, position in px and mm, width/height, pressure, pointerType; listens to Pointer Events AND Touch Events (touches.length, radiusX/Y, force) and shows both counts.
3. Big counters: active now and MAX seen simultaneously (pointer and touch separately), navigator.maxTouchPoints, pointercancel count, devicePixelRatio, screen and viewport size, user agent.
4. Screen diagonal input (default 43, in inches) → mm per CSS px from the screen aspect; show distances between touches in mm and group touches closer than 70 mm into clusters: for each cluster show the number of points, side lengths in mm and angles — this is the token​-geometry readout.
5. Token​ test: per touch, its lifetime in seconds; a log of down/up/cancel with durations; a clear hint "Поставьте фишку, держите, потом отпустите руку — если точки остались, фишка видна без руки".
6. Buttons (≥ 48 px, icon + one word): «Сброс», «Отчёт» — copies a plain-text report (all maxima, maxTouchPoints, UA, diagonal, cancel count, longest lifetimes, last clusters with distances) to the clipboard and also shows it in a sheet so it can be photographed.
7. A short 4-step instruction overlay on first open (all fingers → token held → [скрыто] → «Отчёт»), dismissible with one tap.
Check it works: in ONE headless Chromium on the hub (run with `nice -n 10` and `echo 1000 > /proc/self/oom_score_adj` in the same shell; kill it by PID afterwards; one browser only), serve claude-code-game-master/build/ai-table-human-gm/touch-lab with `python3 -m http.server <free port> --bind 127.0.0.1` (kill by PID after), use CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent to put 5 simultaneous touch points (two of them forming a 3-point cluster ~20–30 mm apart at 43″), move one, release some; take screenshots at 1920×1080 and 390×844 into claude-code-game-master/build/ai-table-human-gm/touch-lab/check/ (PNG or WebP ≤ 400 KB); confirm: max counter shows 5, cluster readout appears with plausible mm, report text contains the numbers, no console errors, document has no scroll (scrollHeight == innerHeight).
Answer (Russian, ≤ 25 lines): first line "TOUCHLAB READY" or "TOUCHLAB FAIL"; what the page shows; the check results with screenshot paths; anything that only a real screen can show.
